name: MossyWoods
layout: A bowl of rolling hills ringed by cliff walls 80 studs high. Centre: a broad grassy basin with the spawn clearing and a stone-tile ruin floor. North: a plateau 40 studs up reached by two dirt ramps, holding the largest ruin (a broken round tower and walls). East: a ridge with a long downhill slide run back into the basin. South: stepped terraces with scattered boulders. West: dense trees around a sunken dell. Dirt paths link the areas. Every area is reachable on foot and by jumping; no dead ends longer than 60 studs.
rules: Boss portal anchors sit at least 220 studs from spawn so finding it takes exploration.
One chest anchor within 60 studs of spawn and one charge shrine anchor within 120 studs (the tutorial placements).
Slopes between 20 and 40 degrees are slide runs; anything above 50 degrees is a cliff and blocks enemies.
The heightfield and the blocked-cell grid are exported as data modules, because the server simulates enemies on them without physics.
Props are real meshes from design/meshes.json, never stacks of primitive parts.

lobby.name: LobbyGlade
lobby.layout: A flat forest clearing with the spawn portal ring on a low stone dais, a lantern post, two trees and a boulder behind where the hero stands; the camera looks at the hero from the front with the scene softly out of focus, as in the reference menus.

lighting.key_light: cool moonlight from the north-east with soft shadows, warm lantern point lights, light bloom, saturated colour grade

note: roblox-map spec. Build from the reference images listed above, never from imagination. Section 2 builds the blockout from this; section 3 builds the full proven layout.
